meta.title: Prompt Wall (dsh-prompt-wall)
meta.description: Unofficial community plugin. A prompt template card wall for image generation: 1077 templates with example images in the sidebar — flip through the masonry cards to pick, with search, categories, favorites and one-click copy. Pick one, copy its code into the chat and say "make an image with this": the agent fetches the prompt, reshapes it for your image model and runs your pipeline. All plugin data stays local; no network needed.
